summary.en: Pro for long-context multimodal analysis; Flash for fast, high-throughput work.
summary.zh: Pro 面向长上下文多模态分析，Flash 面向快速高吞吐任务。

title.en: Gemini 3.1 Pro vs 3.8 Flash: Context, Features and Use Cases
title.zh: Gemini 3.1 Pro 与 3.8 Flash：上下文、能力与用途对比

description.en: Compare Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview and Gemini 3.8 Flash by 1M+ context, multimodal analysis, speed, image models, and suitable workloads.
description.zh: 对比 Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview 与 Gemini 3.8 Flash 的 1M+ 上下文、多模态分析、速度、生图型号与适用任务。

keywords.zh: Gemini Pro 和 Flash 对比

title.zh: Gemini 3.1 Pro 与 3.8 Flash 对比。

description.en: Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview is the lane for large, mixed inputs. Gemini 3.8 Flash is the lane for quick turns and repeated lightweight work.
description.zh: Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview 适合大型混合输入；Gemini 3.8 Flash 适合快速响应和重复轻量任务。

value.zh: 长文本 · 图像 · 混合材料

title.en: An analyst for material that is too large or varied to inspect piecemeal.
title.zh: 面对庞大或混合资料时，更像一位整体分析者。

description.en: Gemini Pro is defined by how much source material it can keep in view; Flash is defined by how quickly it can turn repeated requests around.
description.zh: Gemini Pro 的价值在于同时把握大量资料；Flash 的价值在于快速周转重复请求。

description.en: Useful when splitting material would hide relationships.
description.zh: 适合拆分材料会丢失关系的任务。

description.en: Useful for frequent, lightweight processing.
description.zh: 适合高频、轻量的处理工作。

description.en: Keeps visual and textual evidence in one analysis.
description.zh: 将视觉证据与文本信息放在同一次分析中。

description.en: Choose Pro for breadth and Flash for pace.
description.zh: 资料规模是瓶颈就选 Pro，周转速度是瓶颈就选 Flash。

title.en: Pro absorbs more; Flash turns work around faster.
title.zh: Pro 处理更大输入，Flash 更快完成周转。

description.en: Both are directly selectable, but they solve different bottlenecks.
description.zh: 两者都可直接选择，但解决的是不同瓶颈。

description.en: Long-context understanding and multimodal image-text analysis.
description.zh: 超长上下文理解与图文多模态分析。

description.en: Low-latency, high-throughput processing for frequent tasks.
description.zh: 面向高频任务的低延迟、高吞吐处理。

description.en: Complex generation, precision editing, multi-image redraw, and style fusion.
description.zh: 复杂画面生成、高精度编辑、多图重绘与风格融合。

description.en: Fast image generation and local edits.
description.zh: 快速图片生成与局部改图。

title.en: Use Gemini when the source set is part of the problem.
title.zh: 当资料规模本身就是问题的一部分时，使用 Gemini。

description.en: These examples depend on seeing relationships across documents, images, or repeated inputs.
description.zh: 这些任务需要在文档、图像或重复输入之间看见关系。

brief.en: Compare a large collection without losing contradictions between sources.
brief.zh: 比较大型资料集，同时保留来源之间的矛盾。

process.en: Pro keeps more of the source set available while forming themes and checking claims.
process.zh: Pro 在归纳主题和核对说法时保留更多原始材料。

outcome.en: A synthesis that remains traceable to the full evidence set.
outcome.zh: 一份仍可追溯完整证据集的综合结论。

brief.en: Review screenshots together with requirements and written feedback.
brief.zh: 结合需求与文字反馈审查多张截图。

process.en: Pro connects layout evidence, text, and constraints in one pass.
process.zh: Pro 在一次处理中连接布局证据、文字与约束。

outcome.en: Prioritized findings grounded in both images and requirements.
outcome.zh: 一份同时基于图像和需求的优先级问题清单。

brief.en: Apply a clear rubric to many small pieces of content.
brief.zh: 依据明确规则处理大量小型内容。

process.en: Flash prioritizes consistent, fast turns over extensive deliberation.
process.zh: Flash 优先保持快速、稳定的处理节奏，而不是展开深度推理。

outcome.en: A processed batch with less turnaround time.
outcome.zh: 以更短周转时间完成的批量结果。

title.en: Long context, mixed inputs, and a faster companion model.
title.zh: 超长上下文、混合输入，以及一个更快的搭档。

description.en: The live chat models cover analysis and throughput; separate Gemini image models run through the drawing Combo.
description.zh: 已上线对话型号覆盖分析与吞吐；独立的 Gemini 图像型号通过画图 Combo 使用。

description.en: Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview is positioned for long documents, large code sets, and cross-file work.
description.zh: Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview 面向长文档、大型代码集与跨文件工作。

description.en: Pro can analyze visual and textual material together in the client workflow.
description.zh: Pro 可在客户端工作流中结合分析图像与文本材料。

description.en: Gemini 3.8 Flash handles frequent lightweight requests with a faster cadence.
description.zh: Gemini 3.8 Flash 以更快节奏处理高频轻量请求。

description.en: Gemini image models are live through `ai-image-drawing`, not the main chat picker.
description.zh: Gemini 图像模型通过 `ai-image-drawing` 上线，不属于主对话选择器。

title.en: Choose by what is slowing the work down.
title.zh: 根据真正拖慢工作的因素进行选择。

items.en: You need to inspect a large source set as a whole.
items.zh: 需要把大型资料集作为一个整体分析。

items.en: The task combines images, text, or many files.
items.zh: 任务同时包含图像、文本或大量文件。

items.en: Relationships across the material matter more than response speed.
items.zh: 材料之间的关系比响应速度更重要。

title.en: Choose Flash or another route when
title.zh: 这些情况改选 Flash 或其他路径

items.en: The task is repeated, lightweight, and latency-sensitive.
items.zh: 任务重复、轻量且对延迟敏感。

items.en: Deep architecture decisions are the main risk; consider Claude Opus.
items.zh: 主要风险是深层架构决策，可考虑 Claude Opus。

items.en: The deliverable is a generated image; use the drawing Combo.
items.zh: 交付物是生成图片，应使用画图 Combo。

title.en: Choose the bottleneck you need to remove.
title.zh: 先判断需要消除的是哪种瓶颈。

description.en: Use when fitting the whole source set into one analysis matters more than response speed.
description.zh: 当一次容纳完整资料比响应速度更重要时使用。

description.en: Use when many small requests must complete quickly and consistently.
description.zh: 当大量小任务需要快速、稳定完成时使用。

question.en: Is Gemini 3.1 Pro still a preview model?
question.zh: Gemini 3.1 Pro 仍是预览版吗？

answer.en: The current client identifier is `gemini-3.1-pro-preview`, so the page preserves the preview label rather than implying general availability.
answer.zh: 当前客户端标识为 `gemini-3.1-pro-preview`，因此页面保留 Preview 标识，不暗示其已全面正式发布。

question.en: Should I always use Pro for better quality?
question.zh: 为了质量是否总该使用 Pro？

answer.en: No. Flash is the better fit when latency and throughput define success; Pro is for context-heavy or multimodal analysis.
answer.zh: 不需要。若成功标准是延迟与吞吐，Flash 更合适；Pro 适合上下文密集或多模态分析。

question.en: What does the 1M+ context help with?
question.zh: 1M+ 上下文适合解决什么问题？

answer.en: It is useful when relationships across a large document set, many files, or mixed text-and-image material need to remain visible in one analysis.
answer.zh: 当一次分析需要保留大型文档集、大量文件或图文混合材料之间的关系时，1M+ 上下文更有价值。

question.en: Which Gemini image-generation models are listed?
question.zh: 有哪些 Gemini 图像生成模型？

answer.en: The matrix lists `gemini-3-pro-image-preview`, `gemini-2.5-flash-image`, and `gemini-3.1-flash-image-preview` for complex generation, editing, and faster image work.
answer.zh: 矩阵列出 `gemini-3-pro-image-preview`、`gemini-2.5-flash-image` 与 `gemini-3.1-flash-image-preview`，分别覆盖复杂生成、编辑与快速生图。

question.en: What is the Gemini 3.1 Pro model ID?
question.zh: Gemini 3.1 Pro 的 Model ID 是什么？

answer.en: The standard model ID is `gemini-3.1-pro-preview`; `3.1-pro` and Gemini 3.1 Pro are display aliases for the same model.
answer.zh: 标准 Model ID 是 `gemini-3.1-pro-preview`；`3.1-pro` 与 Gemini 3.1 Pro 是同一模型的展示别名。

title.en: Use Pro for breadth. Use Flash for pace.
title.zh: 需要广度选 Pro，需要速度选 Flash。

description.en: Both Gemini routes stay connected to the same files and project workflow.
description.zh: 两条 Gemini 路径都与同一套文件和项目工作流保持连接。
